Joe and became Snake Eyes III following the death of Snake Eyes. Dr. Venom Dr. Venom was a scientist working for Cobra. He was the inventor of the Brainwave Scanner. Snake Eyes is an Epic Outfit in Fortnite: Battle Royale that can be bought in the Item Shop for 1,800 V-Bucks. He released on January 30th, 2021, and is a part of the Arashikage Clan Set. Snake Eyes is from the G.I Joe Franchise, and his design is also based off of Hasbro's new Snake Eyes action figure.
